sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Last year, my family and I took a vacation to Alaska.
sentences.zh: 去年，我和家人去阿拉斯加度了个假。

sentences.en: This was a much-needed, long-planned break.
sentences.zh: 这是一次蓄谋已久、十分必要的放松。

sentences.en: The best part?
sentences.zh: 最棒的部分是什么？

sentences.en: I got to walk on the top of a glacier.
sentences.zh: 我有机会走在冰川的顶端。

sentences.en: The pale blue ice was translucent.
sentences.zh: 淡蓝色的冰体呈半透明状。

sentences.en: Sharp ridges opened up into crevices dozens of feet deep.
sentences.zh: 锋利的冰脊裂开，形成几十英尺深的冰缝。

sentences.en: Every geological feature, every hill, every valley was sculpted in ice.
sentences.zh: 每一个地质特征，每一座小山，每一条山谷，都是由冰雕琢而成的。

sentences.en: It was a sunny day, and I spotted a small stream of melted water.
sentences.zh: 那天阳光明媚，我发现了一小股融水溪流。

sentences.en: I got on the ground and drank some.
sentences.zh: 我趴在地上喝了一些。

sentences.en: I wondered how long this water had remained frozen.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这些水被冻住有多久了。

sentences.en: The little stream is not the only ice that's melting in Alaska.
sentences.zh: 这条小溪并不是阿拉斯加唯一在融化的冰。

sentences.en: The Mendenhall Glacier, one of the chief tourist attractions in Juneau,
sentences.zh: 门登霍尔冰川是朱诺的主要旅游景点之一，

sentences.en: has retreated over one and a half miles in the last half century.
sentences.zh: 在过去半个世纪里已经退缩了一英里半以上。

sentences.en: Today, you can only see a small sliver of the glacier's tongue from a lookout.
sentences.zh: 如今，你从观景台上只能看到冰川舌的一小部分。

sentences.en: I caught up with John Neary, a Forest Service official,
sentences.zh: 我采访了森林管理局官员约翰·尼里，

sentences.en: who tries to explain to visitors the scale of the changes that they're witnessing.
sentences.zh: 他试图向游客解释他们正在见证的变化规模。

sentences.en: I would say that right now we're looking at a glacier that's filling up.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，现在我们看到的冰川正在消退。

sentences.en: Out of our 180-degree view we have, we're looking at maybe 10 or 15 degrees of it.
sentences.zh: 在我们180度的视野中，我们大概只能看到10度或15度。

sentences.en: Whereas if we stood in the same place 100 years ago,
sentences.zh: 而如果我们100年前站在同一个地方，

sentences.en: it would have filled up about 160 degrees of our view.
sentences.zh: 它会占据我们大约160度的视野。

sentences.en: You are kidding.
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吧。

sentences.en: 160 degrees of our view?
sentences.zh: 占据我们160度的视野？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the reality of how big this was.
sentences.zh: 这就是它曾经有多么宏大的现实。

sentences.en: It's been retreating up this valley at about 40 or 50 feet a year.
sentences.zh: 它正以每年大约40到50英尺的速度向这条山谷上方退缩。

sentences.en: Most recently, 400 feet a year.
sentences.zh: 最近甚至是每年400英尺。

sentences.en: And even more dramatically recently is the thinning and the narrowing
sentences.zh: 更戏剧性的是最近的变薄和变窄，

sentences.en: as it's just sort of collapsed in on itself in the bottom of this valley.
sentences.zh: 因为它就在这片山谷的底部向内坍塌了。

sentences.en: Instead of dominating much of the valley and being able to see white as a large portion of the landscape,
sentences.zh: 它不再占据山谷的大部分并让人们在风景中看到大片白色，

sentences.en: it's now becoming this little ribbon that's at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 而是变成底部的一小条带子。

sentences.en: John is a quiet, soft-spoken man.
sentences.zh: 约翰是一个安静、轻声细语的人。

sentences.en: In recent years, as he's watched the glacier literally recede before his eyes,
sentences.zh: 近年来，当他看着冰川在自己眼前实实在在地退缩时，

sentences.en: he's started to speak up.
sentences.zh: 他开始发声了。

sentences.en: Not just about what's happening, but what it means.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是关于正在发生的事情，还有这意味着什么。

sentences.en: But as I was chatting with John, a visitor came up to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 但正当我和约翰聊天时，一位游客走过来和他说话。

sentences.en: The man said he used to serve in the Air Force
sentences.zh: 那个人说他曾在空军服役，

sentences.en: and had last seen the Mendenhall Glacier a quarter century ago.
sentences.zh: 上一次见到门登霍尔冰川还是在四分之一世纪前。

sentences.en: There was a look in the man's eyes.
sentences.zh: 那个人眼神里有一种神情。

sentences.en: It was a combination of awe and horror.
sentences.zh: 那是敬畏与惊恐的结合。

sentences.en: How could this have happened, the man asked John.
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能发生呢，那个人问约翰。

sentences.en: Why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: In many ways, people don't want to grasp the reality.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，人们不想去接受这个现实。

sentences.en: It's a scary reality to try to grasp.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很难让人去接受的可怕现实。

sentences.en: And so what they naturally want to do is assume,
sentences.zh: 因此他们自然而然想做的是去假设，

sentences.en: well, this has always happened, it will happen in the future and we'll survive, won't we?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这种事以前一直发生，未来也会发生，我们会活下来的，对吧？

sentences.en: They want an assurance from me.
sentences.zh: 他们想要从我这里得到保证。

sentences.en: But I don't give it to them.
sentences.zh: 但我不会给他们。

sentences.en: I don't think it's my job to give them that assurance.
sentences.zh: 我认为给他们这种保证不是我的工作。

sentences.en: I think they need to grasp the reality of the fact that we are entering into a time
sentences.zh: 我认为他们需要认清这样一个现实：我们正在进入一个时期

sentences.en: when, yes, glacial advance and retreat has happened 25 different times to North America over its long life,
sentences.zh: ——是的，在北漫长的生命中，冰川的前进和后退已经发生过25次了，

sentences.en: but never at the rate and the scale that we see now.
sentences.zh: 但从未达到我们现在看到的这种速度和规模。

sentences.en: And in the very quick rapidity of it means that species probably won't be able to adapt
sentences.zh: 而且这种极快的速度意味着物种可能无法像过去那样

sentences.en: the way that they have in the past over a longer period of time.
sentences.zh: 在较长的时间内进行适应。

sentences.en: To be clear, the Mendenhall Glacier's retreat, in and of itself, is not proof of climate change.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，门登霍尔冰川的退缩本身并不是气候变化的证据。

sentences.en: That evidence comes from a range of scientific measurements and calculations.
sentences.zh: 这些证据来自一系列科学测量和计算。

sentences.en: But the glacier is a visible symbol of the changes that scientists are documenting.
sentences.zh: 但这座冰川是科学家们正在记录的变化的有形象征。

sentences.en: It's interesting, I think, when people think about climate change,
sentences.zh: 我认为有趣的是，当人们想到气候变化时，

sentences.en: it tends to be an abstract issue most of the time for most people,
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，它往往是一个抽象的问题，

sentences.en: that you're standing in front of this magnificent glacier right now,
sentences.zh: 而你现在正站在这个壮丽的冰川前，

sentences.en: and to actually see it receding makes it feel real and visceral
sentences.zh: 亲眼看到它在退缩，让它变得真实而直观，

sentences.en: in a way that it just isn't when I'm living in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这是我在华盛顿特区生活时所没有的感觉。

sentences.en: Oh, I agree.
sentences.zh: 哦，我同意。

sentences.en: I think that for too many people, the issue is some Micronesian island
sentences.zh: 我认为对太多人来说，这个问题只是某个密克罗尼西亚的岛屿，

sentences.en: that's having an extra inch of water this year on their shorelines,
sentences.zh: 今年他们的海岸线上多了一英寸的水，

sentences.en: or it's some polar bears far up in the Arctic that they're really not connected with.
sentences.zh: 或者是北极深处的一些北极熊，他们与这些并没有真正的联系。

sentences.en: But when they realize they come here and they're on this nice day like we're experiencing right now
sentences.zh: 但当他们意识到自己来到这里，正处在我们现在经历的这样一个美好日子里，

sentences.en: with the warm sun, and they start to think about this glacier melting
sentences.zh: 阳光温暖，他们开始思考这座冰川为什么在融化，

sentences.en: and why it's receding, why it's disappearing,
sentences.zh: 为什么在退缩，为什么在消失，

sentences.en: why it doesn't look like that photo just 30 years ago up in the visitor center,
sentences.zh: 为什么它看起来不像游客中心里仅仅30年前的那张照片，

sentences.en: it becomes real for them and they have to start grappling with the issues behind it.
sentences.zh: 这一切对他们来说就变得真实了，他们不得不开始面对背后的问题。

sentences.en: I could see tourists turning these questions over in their minds as they watched the glacier.
sentences.zh: 我能看到游客们在看着冰川时，脑子里在琢磨这些问题。

sentences.en: So even though I had not planned to do any reporting,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管我原本没打算做任何报道，

sentences.en: I started interviewing people using the only device I had available, my phone.
sentences.zh: 我还是开始用我手头唯一的设备——我的手机采访人们。

sentences.en: I just think it's a shame that we are losing something pretty precious and pretty different in the world.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得可惜，我们正在失去世界上一些非常珍贵且非常独特的东西。

sentences.en: This is Dale Singer.
sentences.zh: 这是戴尔·辛格。

sentences.en: She and her family came to Alaska on a cruise to celebrate a couple of family birthdays.
sentences.zh: 她和家人乘游轮来到阿拉斯加庆祝几个家庭生日。

sentences.en: This was her second trip to Mendenhall.
sentences.zh: 这是她第二次来门登霍尔。

sentences.en: She came about nine years ago, but the weather was so foggy, she couldn't get a good look.
sentences.zh: 她大约九年前来过，但当时天气太雾了，她没能看清楚。

sentences.en: She felt compelled to come back.
sentences.zh: 她觉得自己必须回来看看。

sentences.en: I asked Dale why she thought the glacier was retreating.
sentences.zh: 我问戴尔她为什么认为冰川在退缩。

sentences.en: Global warming, whether we like to admit it or not, it's our fault.
sentences.zh: 全球变暖，不管我们愿不愿意承认，都是我们的错。

sentences.en: Or something we're doing is affecting climate change.
sentences.zh: 或者我们正在做的某些事情正在影响气候变化。

sentences.en: Others are not so sure.
sentences.zh: 其他人则没那么确定。

sentences.en: For some of Dale's fellow passengers on her cruise, this is a touchy topic.
sentences.zh: 对于戴尔游轮上的某些同伴来说，这是一个敏感的话题。

sentences.en: Somebody just said they went to a lecture on the ship,
sentences.zh: 刚才有人说他们去听了船上的一场讲座，

sentences.en: and the lecturer did not use the word global warming nor climate change
sentences.zh: 演讲者没有使用“全球变暖”或“气候变化”这两个词，

sentences.en: because he didn't want to offend passengers.
sentences.zh: 因为他不想冒犯乘客。

sentences.en: So there are still people who refuse to admit it.
sentences.zh: 所以仍然有人拒绝承认这一点。

sentences.en: As I was standing next to John,
sentences.zh: 当我站在约翰旁边时，

sentences.en: one man carefully came up and listened to his account of the science of climate change.
sentences.zh: 有一个人小心翼翼地走过来，听他讲述关于气候变化的科学解释。

sentences.en: When John was done talking,
sentences.zh: 当约翰讲完时，

sentences.en: the man told him that he wouldn't trust scientists as far as he could throw them.
sentences.zh: 那个人告诉他，他对科学家的话连一个标点符号都不信。

sentences.en: Climate change was all about politics, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，气候变化全都是政治把戏。

sentences.en: I asked the man for an interview, but he declined.
sentences.zh: 我邀请那个人接受采访，但他拒绝了。

sentences.en: He said his company had contracts with the federal government,
sentences.zh: 他说他的公司与联邦政府有合同，

sentences.en: and if bureaucrats in the Obama administration
sentences.zh: 如果奥巴马政府的官僚们

sentences.en: heard his skeptical views on climate change,
sentences.zh: 听到他对气候变化的怀疑观点，

sentences.en: those contracts might mysteriously disappear.
sentences.zh: 这些合同可能会神秘地消失。

sentences.en: I caught up with another touriSt.
sentences.zh: 我采访了另一位游客。

sentences.en: I asked Michael Bull if he believed climate change was real.
sentences.zh: 我问迈克尔·布尔是否相信气候变化是真实的。

sentences.en: No, I think there's global climate change,
sentences.zh: 不，我认为存在全球气候变化，

sentences.en: but I question whether it's all due to human interaction with the Earth.
sentences.zh: 但我怀疑这是否全都是人类与地球互动造成的。

sentences.en: Yes, you can't deny that the climate is changing,
sentences.zh: 是的，你不能否认气候在变暖，

sentences.en: but the causation of that, I'm not sold on as being our fault.
sentences.zh: 但其起因，我并不认为完全是我们的错。

sentences.en: Michael was worried his tour bus might leave without him,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔担心他的旅游大巴可能会把他落下，

sentences.en: so he answered my question about whether the glacier's retreat
sentences.zh: 所以他在怠速运转的大巴旁回答了我关于冰川退缩

sentences.en: was cause for alarm, standing next to the idling bus.
sentences.zh: 是否值得担忧的问题。

sentences.en: So what's the bad part of the glacier receding?
sentences.zh: 那么冰川退缩有什么坏处呢？

sentences.en: And, you know, from what John said to me,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，根据约翰对我说的话，

sentences.en: if it's the rate at which and the Earth can't adapt,
sentences.zh: 如果这种速度超出了地球的适应能力，

sentences.en: that makes sense to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说倒说得通。

sentences.en: But I think the final story is yet to be written.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最终的结局尚未写定。

sentences.en: I think Mother Earth pushes back.
sentences.zh: 我认为大地母亲会进行反击。

sentences.en: So I don't think we're going to destroy her
sentences.zh: 所以我不认为我们会毁灭她，

sentences.en: because I think she'll take care of us before we take care of her.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为在我们照顾她之前，她会先照顾我们。

sentences.en: Nugget Falls is a beautiful waterfall that empties into Mendenhall Lake.
sentences.zh: 纽盖特瀑布是一座美丽的瀑布，最终注入门登霍尔湖。

sentences.en: When John first came to Alaska in 1982,
sentences.zh: 当约翰在1982年首次来到阿拉斯加时，

sentences.en: the waterfall was adjacent to the glacier.
sentences.zh: 瀑布就紧挨着冰川。

sentences.en: Today, there's a gap of three-quarters of a mile
sentences.zh: 如今，瀑布和冰川之间有四分之三英里宽的空隙。

sentences.en: between the waterfall and the glacier.
sentences.zh: 瀑布和冰川之间有四分之三英里宽的空隙。

sentences.en: The glacier has receded unbelievably.
sentences.zh: 冰川退缩得令人难以置信。

sentences.en: It's quite shocking.
sentences.zh: 这相当令人震惊。

sentences.en: This is Sue Schultz.
sentences.zh: 这是苏·舒尔茨。

sentences.en: She said she lived in Juneau back in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 她说她曾在20世纪80年代住在朱诺。

sentences.en: This was her first time back in 28 years.
sentences.zh: 这是她28年来第一次回来。

sentences.en: What did it look like 28 years ago?
sentences.zh: 28年前这里是什么样子的？

sentences.en: The bare rock that you see to the left
sentences.zh: 当你面对冰川时，

sentences.en: as you face the glacier was glacier.
sentences.zh: 左边看到的裸露岩石以前都是冰川。

sentences.en: And we used to hike on the other side of it.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常常在它的另一侧远足。

sentences.en: You could take a trail right onto the glacier.
sentences.zh: 你可以走一条小径直接登上冰川。

sentences.en: And what about this way?
sentences.zh: 那这边呢？

sentences.en: I understand the glacier actually came significantly over to this side
sentences.zh: 据我了解，冰川实际上曾显著地延伸到这一侧，

sentences.en: close to Nugget Falls.
sentences.zh: 靠近纽盖特瀑布。

sentences.en: Yes, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: It was really close.
sentences.zh: 离得非常近。

sentences.en: In fact, the lake was a lot smaller, obviously.
sentences.zh: 事实上，很显然，那时的湖泊要小得多。

sentences.en: I mean, yeah, it's quite incredible.
sentences.zh: 我是说，是的，这相当不可思议。

sentences.en: And so what's your reaction when you see it?
sentences.zh: 那么当你看到它时，你的反应是什么？

sentences.en: Global warming.
sentences.zh: 全球变暖。

sentences.en: We need to pay attention.
sentences.zh: 我们需要重视起来。

sentences.en: Even if it all melts, it's not going to be the end of the world.
sentences.zh: 即使它完全融化了，也不会是世界末日。

sentences.en: So I'm not worried.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不担心。

sentences.en: Terry Lambert is a tourist from Southern California.
sentences.zh: 特里·兰伯特是来自南加州的游客。

sentences.en: He's never visited Mendenhall before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未参观过门登霍尔。

sentences.en: He thinks the melting glacier is just part of nature's plan.
sentences.zh: 他认为冰川融化只是大自然计划的一部分。

sentences.en: Well, it's just like earthquakes and floods and hurricanes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就像地震、洪水和飓风一样。

sentences.en: They're just all part of what's going on.
sentences.zh: 它们都是正在发生的事情的一部分。

sentences.en: You can't control it.
sentences.zh: 你无法控制它。

sentences.en: You can't change it.
sentences.zh: 你无法改变它。

sentences.en: And I personally don't think it's something that man's doing that's making that melt.
sentences.zh: 而且我个人不认为冰川融化是人类造成的。

sentences.en: I mentioned to Terry some of the possible consequences of climate change on various species.
sentences.zh: 我向特里提到了气候变化对各个物种可能产生的一些影响。

sentences.en: Well, there could be changes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能会有变化。

sentences.en: Some species could be advantaged.
sentences.zh: 某些物种可能会从中受益。

sentences.en: Some species could be disadvantaged.
sentences.zh: 某些物种可能会受到不利影响。

sentences.en: The ecosystem is changing.
sentences.zh: 生态系统正在发生变化。

sentences.en: You're going to have flooding.
sentences.zh: 你们将会遭遇洪水。

sentences.en: You could have weather events, right?
sentences.zh: 可能会出现极端天气，对吧？

sentences.en: There could be consequences that affect you and I.
sentences.zh: 可能会产生影响你我的后果。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But like I said, so far in the future, I'm not worried about it.
sentences.zh: 但就像我说的，那是很遥远的事，我并不为此担心。

sentences.en: I realized at that moment that the debate over climate change is no longer really about science,
sentences.zh: 那一刻我意识到，关于气候变化的争论实际上已经不再是关于科学的了，

sentences.en: unless the science you're talking about is the study of human behavior.
sentences.zh: 除非你所说的科学是对人类行为的研究。

sentences.en: I asked John why he thought so many people were unwilling to accept the scientific consensus
sentences.zh: 我问约翰，为什么他认为有那么多人不愿意接受这样一个科学共识：

sentences.en: that climate change was having real consequences.
sentences.zh: 即气候变化正在带来真正的后果。

sentences.en: The inability to do anything about it themselves, because it's threatening to think about giving
sentences.zh: 他们自己对此无能为力，因为一想到要放弃汽车、放弃家里的
